chunk_findings.detail: JSON answers never name a next call. Given `format="json"`, `run_perf_report` sets `text` to `json.dumps(RT.to_json(report))` only and returns that as the chat body. The intent and [r-tell-dont-discover] require every answer to name the exact next CLI and MCP calls; text/md/svg/html go through `_footer`, json does not, so a machine-readable report is the one form that omits them.

chunk_findings.detail: `svg` writes one file by joining every chart with `"\n\n".join(charts.values())`. When both gate p90 and model pass-rate rows exist, that is two full SVG documents in `report-<ts>.svg`. Opening that path (the next call the footer tells the user to use) is not a single SVG document, so the file the report just wrote does not render.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/api/perfreport.py:145

chunk_findings.detail: SVG/HTML delivery inlines the whole document with no cap: `body = f"path: {path}\n{doc}\n..."`. The stated remote/shell-less contract is file content inline only up to a bound. A report whose chart HTML/SVG exceeds that bound is still returned in full in `Outcome.text`, so the inline path is unbounded.

chunk_findings.detail: Text and markdown next-calls are built with an empty `out`: `_footer(fmt, "", win)` yields `ddflow perf report --format text --window <win> --out ` (and the same MCP form). Copying that exact command fails because `--out`/`out=` is present with no value. SVG/HTML do not have this hole; the default text path does.

chunk_findings.detail: The confirmed inline-bound defect is not fixed; the write path now drops file content entirely. Intent and PM-remote require the remote/shell-less answer to include the exact command and the SVG/HTML inline up to a bound, because the server may not share a filesystem with the user. chunk_findings.detail: The model rows extraction uses `r["name"]`, but model comparison dictionaries typically use `r["model"]` or `r["id"]` as the key for the model identifier in the `report` object produced by `build(ctx)`. If the underlying model records use a different key, `r.get("name")` will return `None` and silently drop all model pass rate charts, leaving the model chart empty.

chunk_findings.detail: In `ddflow/surfaces/declared/perfremote.py`, the `Param` definitions for `window`, `filters`, `format`, and `out` have no `cli_short` or short options configured, yet the help strings refer to options like `--window`, `--filters`, `--format`, and `--out`. Given that `ddflow` CLI parameter parsing expects explicit flag configurations for non-positional arguments, omitting explicit short or long flags in the parser parameters for `window`, `filters`, `format`, and `out` leads to a CLI parse error `unrecognized arguments: --format json` when invoking `ddflow perf report --format json` through the declared surface's parameter definitions.
